characters.notes: Historical figure discussed at length by Elyas. His statue's eye is the landmark where they camp. United vast lands, brought peace and justice with fire and sword, besieged Tar Valon for twenty years, died the day his statue was completed. His death sparked the War of the Hundred Years.

appearances.whereabouts: Leading Perrin and Egwene south across the plains, eventually into a stedding with Artur Hawkwing's statue
appearances.notable_actions: Pushes the group hard to stay ahead of searching ravens; takes extreme precautions to hide their trail; scouts each ridge carefully; communicates with distant wolves under great strain; leads them into the safety of a stedding; builds a fire against the rock of Hawkwing's statue; tells the history of Artur Hawkwing and the statue
appearances.demeanor: Urgent, wary, tense, impatient, taunting to keep them moving; later more relaxed once in the stedding but still watchful

appearances.whereabouts: Fleeing south with Elyas and Egwene, eventually reaching a stedding
appearances.notable_actions: Scouts ridges with Elyas; witnesses ravens killing a fox; fumbles with his sling while Egwene kills a raven; experiences direct mental communication with wolves including sensing their battle with ravens and sharing their pain; exchanges glances with Elyas acknowledging the wolf connection; struggles with exhaustion; considers whether he could kill Egwene to spare her a worse death; plunges into the pool in the stedding; helps prepare the meal in gloomy silence
appearances.demeanor: Increasingly troubled and withdrawn; terrified by the ravens; tormented by dark thoughts about violence; guilt-ridden about his wolf connection; avoiding Egwene's eyes; brooding and silent

appearances.whereabouts: Riding Bela and fleeing south with Perrin and Elyas, eventually reaching a stedding
appearances.notable_actions: Rides Bela during the flight; kills a raven with her sling; exchanges riding with Perrin as they both tire; openly acknowledges that Perrin can talk to wolves; tries to maintain cheerful spirits; splashes water at Perrin at the pool; helps prepare the meal; studies the carved eye and questions Elyas about Artur Hawkwing
appearances.demeanor: Initially anxious and fearful; briefly relieved when they reach a ridge without ravens; resourceful in killing the raven; increasingly worried about Perrin's withdrawal; tries to be cheerful but becomes subdued; curious about the history

appearances.whereabouts: Carrying Egwene (and sometimes Perrin) during the flight south into the stedding
appearances.notable_actions: Carries riders during the exhausting flight; shows signs of exhaustion; responds positively to entering the stedding with raised head and flaring nostrils
appearances.demeanor: Tired, head down and nostrils flaring at stops; alert and expectant upon entering the stedding

appearances.whereabouts: Initially scouting far to the south, then fighting ravens to the north, then racing south to rejoin the group
appearances.notable_actions: Scouts ahead; battles ravens in a fierce fight; suffers wounds; gathers the wounded pack; leads them south to warn Elyas and the others; communicates mentally with Elyas and Perrin
appearances.demeanor: Determined, protective, wounded but undeterred; focused on the mission despite injuries

appearances.whereabouts: Fighting ravens to the north, then racing south with the pack
appearances.notable_actions: Fights ravens; suffers eye damage and other wounds; continues with the pack despite injuries
appearances.demeanor: Wounded, in pain, but continuing on with determination

appearances.whereabouts: Fighting ravens to the north, then racing south with the pack
appearances.notable_actions: Fights ravens; suffers a puncture wound on left foreleg; licks the wound; continues with the pack
